title: Time and Materials Ticket Template
工时与材料工单模板
description: A printable T&M ticket with labor, materials, equipment and on-site acknowledgment, plus a spreadsheet-ready CSV.
可打印的工时与材料工单，涵盖人工、材料、设备及现场签认，并提供可导入电子表格的 CSV。
fields: 材料：项目、数量、单位、成本
note: Use additional sheets for itemized work. This record is not a contract or a guarantee of payment. Define what the acknowledgment confirms.
明细较多时使用附页。这是记录工具，不是合同或付款保证；请明确签认确认的事项。

title: Equipment Checkout Log Template
器材借出归还记录模板
description: Track the asset, borrower, expected return, actual return and condition without an account or registration.
无需账号或注册，即可记录器材编号、借用人、预计及实际归还时间、状态和交接签认。
note: Use one record for each checkout. Keep past transactions when an item is borrowed again.
每次借出使用一条记录，同一器材再次借出时保留此前交接历史。

title: Puppy Weight Log Template
幼犬体重记录模板
description: A simple puppy identification, date, weight and care-notes sheet in printable and spreadsheet formats.
提供可打印及电子表格格式，记录幼犬标识、日期、体重、喂养与护理备注，方便统一整理每次观察。
note: Record observations only. This log does not diagnose illness or recommend treatment. Discuss health concerns with a veterinarian.
仅记录观察情况。本表不诊断疾病，也不提供治疗建议；健康问题请联系兽医。

title: Calving Record Sheet
产犊记录表
description: Record season, dam and calf IDs, birth details and observations on paper or in a spreadsheet.
在纸面或电子表格中记录产犊季、母牛与犊牛编号、出生详情及观察，便于日后核对和整理。
note: Use your existing record definitions; identify unknown values explicitly. This is a record sheet, not veterinary guidance.
沿用已有记录定义，未知值明确注明。本表仅用于记录，不提供兽医诊疗指导。

title: Heat Press Settings Log Template
热压参数记录模板
description: Record material, blank, transfer, actual settings and wash-test results without invented universal temperatures.
记录材料、坯件、转印类型、实际参数和水洗测试结果；不提供虚构的通用最佳温度，方便复核自己的试样。
note: Follow the material, transfer and equipment manufacturer instructions. Record your actual settings; this sheet supplies no recommended temperature.
遵循材料、转印产品与设备厂商的说明，记录实际参数；本表不提供建议温度。

title: Repeat Customer Invoice Template
回头客发票模板
description: An invoice worksheet for recurring service customers with quantity, rate, amount, date and invoice number.
面向重复服务客户的发票工作表，包含服务描述、数量、单价、金额、日期及发票编号，便于逐次核对。
note: Recheck quantities, rates and customer details for every invoice. This worksheet provides no tax or legal advice.
每张发票均重新核对数量、单价和客户信息。本表不提供税务或法律建议。
